verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a developer API platform for cards, payments, transactions and expense data, with TypeScript and Python SDKs and mTLS/OAuth 2.0 authentication. Its MCP server also lets agents act without opening the app, so the product can be driven programmatically without its UI. There is no CLI and no documentation of CI pipelines, non-interactive auth flows or a headless mode, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/non-interactive auth guidance (e.g. service accounts/client credentials), published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of automated usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: API Platform: Developer APIs for cards, payments, transactions, and expense data. Launched December 2025.
Batch payments, real-time webhooks, TypeScript and Python SDKs. Full integration in under a sprint.
The Jeeves API uses mTLS and OAuth 2.0 to authenticate requests.
all without opening the Jeeves app
